headline: Small clean summer leftovers — a mellow log day.
today: Waist-high at most, 1.4-1.6ft at 4s from a good S angle, with light-to-moderate W cross wind keeping it rideable. It's not going to be memorable, but it's surfable on a log through the morning. Nothing worth rushing for.

daysToWatch.note: Similar small size but wind goes light-to-glassy through the middle of the day. Cleanest little log session of the early week.
Prime SE angle at up to ~10s period, but the swell is tiny at under a foot. Surf the calm morning before the afternoon SW cross-on ramps to 20mph and shuts it down.

Big jump on the cards: swell ranges up to 3.8ft, total to 4.4ft, from a good angle. Dawn is cross-on and windy at 22mph but it swings NW cross-off by morning. This is the day worth rearranging plans for — shortboard.
